title: Microsoft 365 Backup full-workload policies slip to 2027
summary: Microsoft updated MC1387526 on 18 November 2026: general availability of Full Workload Backup in Microsoft 365 Backup now starts in January 2027 and should complete by end of February 2027, previously mid-September to mid-October 2026 (roadmap 464990). The feature, in preview since July, protects every eligible SharePoint site, OneDrive account or Exchange mailbox not covered by a custom policy with one policy per workload, adds new items automatically (checked every 24 hours per Learn), lets custom policies take precedence and supports CSV exclusions.
why: Without it, new mailboxes and sites stay unprotected until someone adds them to a policy, which is the gap most tenants script around. If you planned to retire a third-party backup or your own enrolment automation on the GA date, that plan now moves by four months.
todo: Keep your existing enrolment automation or third-party backup until GA reaches your tenant.
If you use the preview, review how removal works: removing a unit from Full Workload Backup puts it on the exclusion list.
Wait: GA January–February 2027 per Microsoft; dates have moved once already.
effective_note: GA rollout January–end February 2027 per MC1387526 (updated 18 Nov 2026).
